META MUSE EMBER COSTS $0.10 PER MILLION INPUT TOKENS. Output is $0.50.

It came out on November 9 and is built for the small, repeated steps inside agent workflows: tool calls, data extraction, routing, parsing long documents. It reads up to 1M tokens and accepts images. Reportedly, Meta has not released the weights.

This is a cheap worker model, not a top model. Prices are from the Vercel AI Gateway listing.

If your agent runs thousands of small steps a day, test Muse Ember on those steps first and compare the bill.
